notes.title: Patch 1.01 Release
notes.notes:
Hey Folks,

 Just a quick patch for the game:

Features:
-Added additional corpse sprites for enemies
-Altered several sprites that I wasn't happy with
-Optimised areas with large numbers of animated tiles (water)
-Optimised some of the GUI to be less performance intensive
-Added shadows to NPC's & the player
-Rebalanced the Arcade Mode Level
-Fixed a bug where swat teams would drop the wrong kind of bullet casing

I've also removed the demo for the time being as I'm not happy with it, should be revamped and back up in a week or so.

Thanks for playing!
